{{for|other pages related to dreams|Dream}}
'''Contagious dreams''' are dreams by powerful channelers that incidentally affect the dreams of other people within the same area.

== Summary ==

Sometimes people in the vicinity of a powerful channeler experience dreams depicting that channeler. While all known source individuals were male, it is not known if it is required for the individual to be male. All known source individuals were exceptionally powerful channelers. The affected area seems be roughly the size of a city, but it may be that it varies depending on certain variables.

[[Moiraine]] implies that the effect is due to the source individual failing to shield their dreams.{{ref/book|3|53}}

== Dreaming ==

This phenomenon is distinct from [[Dreaming]] and [[Dreamwalking]], where the dreamer sees prophetic visions, enters {{tar}}, enters another's dreams intentionally, or is pulled into another's dreams.

* [[Rand al'Thor]] -

** [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]{{ref/book|3|51}}

** [[Egwene al'Vere]]{{ref/book|3|54}} - Egwene's dreams could be a result of her [[Dreaming]] instead of this phenomenon

A substantial portion of the population of [[Tear (city)]] dreamed of Rand and [[Ba'alzamon]] during the First Battle of the Stone.{{ref/book|3|56}} However, since neither Rand nor Ba'alzamon were sleeping at the time, it is unclear how related this event was to this phenomenon. It may have been a side effect of their activities in {{tar}}, and it might have something to do with Rand's {{tav}} nature.
